公司介绍
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. Follow @abbvie on X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Tik Tok.
职位描述
The IAI Site Services Lead will be part of an exciting, highly collaborative, friendly, supportive, and talented team. Responsible for the China End User Computing and Core Infrastructure, working with the global organisation to anticipates the business need, delivers the requirements of commercial initiatives and support AbbVie’s goals. They will manage all relevant vendors to maximize value for the business whilst leveraging the global scale. The IAI Site Services Lead will have a reporting line into the JAPAC Site Service Leader.
-	Local management of all IT infrastructure coordination, managing the site support teams to facilitate incident resolution across all areas incl. CCF, end user support, collaboration, communication & network through support partners as well as regional & global teams across all China sites to ensure a best in class service with no interruption of services during office hours.
-	Identifies, defines, negotiates, coordinates and tightly monitors services being delivered by Managed Service Partners (MSPs) i. e. HCL, ITSD.
-	Represents the BTS IAI organization for the China sites, communicating the technology strategy and developing implementation patterns that are aligned with global guidelines. Understands and contributes to the BTS IAI organization's vision, goals and strategies. Aligns department priorities appropriately, determines critical success factors, evaluates and pursues initiatives, investments and opportunities based on fit with strategies.
-	The coordination and management all IT site support for the Onboarding and offboarding of employees/contract staff including the provision of hardware, software, telephony and mobility management, via the correct global departments to ensure continued service.
-	Ordering and managing the inventory for all local IT equipment.
-	Ensure all customers get regular scheduled upgrades to equipment as per the current Abbvie policy.
-	As part of an ongoing continuous improvement activity, regularly review all local IT processes, tech solutions for efficiencies.
-	Establish and manage working relationships with external partners/vendors whilst ensuring service levels and appropriate cover across sites.
-	Accountable for regular IT disposal activities including the coordination with finance and the usage of ethically approved global vendors.
-	Management of all Video conferencing, telephony services, print services, meeting management/Room booking solutions and coordination for global IT security solutions.
-	Guidance and signposting of supporting the self-serve principles where sensible.
-	Act as an escalation to global or local IT issues to the BTS IT Director or global reporting line.
-	Financial management of agreed local budgets for purchasing technology aligned with corporate policy.
职位要求
-	Significant working knowledge within IT with hands-on experience that will include managing external resources, technology support, leading cross functional projects, business systems analysis / business process transformation and potentially software development and deployment.
-	Minimum 4 years in a supervisor IT support role and overall 10 + years experience in IT.
-	Ability to work in a Global organisations, particularly matrix organisations with proven experience of working in multi-functional regional and global solutions teams. This will include all aspects of the software lifecycle; requirements gathering, through implementation and into on-going support.
-	Experienced in Cloud services & architecture.
-	Focuses on end user and customer centricity.
-	Passion for learning new tools.
-	Able to work with minimal direct guidance.
-	Fast adaptation to changing requirements.
-	A powerful desire to find innovative solutions to complex problems and attention to detail.
-	Strong problem-solving skills.
-	Tenacity, Enthusiasm, and a Team-mindset.
-	Effective cross-functional engagement skills.
-	Strong oral and written communication skills.
-	Experience in Biotech/Pharma industry preferred.
-	Expert knowledge of ITIL disciplines.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, serving our community and embracing diversity and inclusion. JOB PURPOSE: This position plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth 
operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure within the designated 
region. It requires a strong understanding of network infrastructure, expertise 
in Azure cloud / M365 services, and proficiency in PowerBI. This position will 
be responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting issues, and 
implementing IT solutions to enhance organizational efficiency.

REPORTING TO: Regional Head of IT Operation

Responsibilities:
 1. Microsoft 365 Service Management:
 · Administer and manage Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, 
SharePoint Online, Intune, Teams, etc.
 · Monitor and optimize M365 service performance, security settings
 2. Azure Cloud Services:
 · Monitor Azure cloud services, including virtual machines, storage, 
networking, and security
 · Work with IT infrastructure team to implement and optimize cloud-based 
solutions
 3. PowerBI Implementation:
 · Utilize PowerBI to create and maintain insightful dashboards and reports 
for decision making purposes
 · Train end-users on PowerBI functionalities and promote data-driven 
decision-making within the region
 4. Network Infrastructure Management:
 · Implement, and maintain regional network infrastructure to ensure optimal 
performance and reliability
 · Troubleshoot and resolve network issues, ensuring minimal downtime and 
efficient resolution
 5. Technical Support:
 · Provide timely and effective technical support to end-users in the region, 
addressing hardware, software, and network-related issues
 · Collaborate with the central IT support team to escalate and resolve 
complex technical problems
 6. Security and Compliance:
 · Implement and enforce IT security policies to safeguard regional systems 
and data
 · Stay informed about industry best practices and ensure compliance with 
relevant regulations
 7. Documentation:
 · Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for network configurations, 
system changes, and troubleshooting procedures
 · Develop and update user guides and documentation for IT-related processes
 8. Collaboration and Communication:
 · Collaborate with other IT professionals, both regionally and centrally, to 
ensure consistency and alignment of IT services
 · Communicate effectively with end-users, management, and other stakeholders on IT-related matters

Qualifications:
 · Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related 
field
 · Proven experience as an IT Technician or similar role, with a focus on M365 
services, Azure cloud, network infrastructure and PowerBI
 · Certification in relevant technologies (e.g., Azure certifications)
 · Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 · Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 · Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team
 · Knowledge of IT security best practices and compliance standards

Preferred Skills:
 · Experience with other cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Ali Cloud Platform)
 · Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell) for automation tasks
